forms.detail: Esketamine is the S-enantiomer (DEA). In the EU, Spravato contains esketamine hydrochloride as a 'Nasal spray, solution' (EMA product information).
DEA: ketamine hydrochloride is a white crystalline powder, soluble in water.
DEA lists the trade names Ketalar, Ketaset, Ketajet, Ketavet, Vetamine, Vetaket and Ketamine Hydrochloride Injection.

DEA: illicit ketamine is found as a dried powder or as liquid in small vials or bottles. EUDA: in 2024 ketamine was seized in the EU mostly as powder; sites have been engaged in the crystallisation of bulk ketamine powders.
EUDA: ketamine is also added alongside stimulants to drug mixtures such as 'pink cocaine' or 'tucibi'; DEA: occasionally found in tablets sold as 'MDMA'.
